title: Fixed Empty Scooped Saddle and Open Stirrups
description: One newly authored complete empty fixed riding-saddle appearance. A single thick double-curved seat scoops down between its narrow raised front pommel and broad rear cantle. Two full broad leather-looking skirts descend from the seat sides, with two whole fixed stirrup leathers carrying separate complete metal-looking open stirrups with finite flat lower treads. All geometry is newly drawn; no cycle saddle, cargo pack yoke, animal or old harness mesh is imported or extracted. Unlike an empty caravan pack frame, there are no wooden cargo ledges or horns; unlike a cycle seat, there is a whole skirt-and-stirrup system and no post or wheel. Three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin; one prop, zero scenes, no horse, rider or cargo. Fixed stylized display only: no live-animal fit, equestrian compatibility, welfare assessment, seat or stirrup ergonomics, strap adjustment, manufacture, carrying load, mounting or riding safety claim.
